concerns.text: The coverage table is keyed on FR-001–FR-007, but spec.md defines no numbered FR list (FR-007 appears only in passing). The tags tasks rely on for traceability reference requirement IDs that don't exist in the spec, so FR coverage cannot be verified against the spec as written. Either the spec must gain a numbered FR list or the tasks table must key on the spec's actual Objectives/Validation Criteria sections.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 contract-test list vs plan.md Phase 9 / SC-005
concerns.text: SC-005 and plan Phase 9 require every output file to have a contract and a non-skipped contract test, but T001's per-file test list omits `sensitivity_variation.csv`, `sensitivity_variation_notes.json`, and `sensitivity_metadata.json` (produced by T007/T008). These outputs have no schema, no contract-test mapping, and no artifact-writer path — they escape the write-then-verify discipline, leaving part of FR-006/SC-005 uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs plan.md Constitution Check VII
concerns.text: Plan's constitution table claims 'spectral norm enforced by explicit scaling and verified post-construction' (Constitution VII), but no task specifies a post-construction verification of P_N's spectral norm θ or sparsity structure, nor records its result in any artifact. The plan element has no covering task.
Coverage table lists SC-001–SC-003 and SC-005 but omits SC-004 (ARPACK tol 1e-10, maxiter 1000), which plan.md declares a constraint and T002 enforces. Add SC-004 → T002/T003 to the coverage map.
